messages:
sam: Heads up 1 my aunt is popping by at 3:15pm to drop off a small celebration cake and a folded walking frame (shell only be 20 mins). Can we print a temp badge and make sure there's an accessible seat?
frontdesk: Yep we can print a visitor badge on arrival. For the walking frame  side alcove by reception is fine if folded. If she needs to leave it unfolded we can put it in locker D2.
sam: She prefers a quiet spot and would like an armchair with high arms to help her sit. Any available?
anya: The armchair in the quiet corner is free after 3pm. I can move a small side table next to it.
leo: Ill free up locker D2 from 3pm-4pm in case she wants to leave the frame unfolded. Leaving the code with frontdesk.
frontdesk: Thanks @leo. We'll also print a polite sign to reserve the armchair for a visitor and make sure there's a small step-free path.
badge-bot: temp badge printed: "Visitor - Sam's Aunt" (expires 16:00).
sam: Cake is nut-free but contains dairy  please fridge it until serving. Also the courier might drop a small package of choir sheet music at 3:05pm; if that arrives, please hold it at the desk and label "Sam - sheets".
frontdesk: Noted. We'll label the cake "contains dairy" and keep it in the small fridge shelf. Courier package will be tagged on arrival.
anya: Poll: offer tea or water for the visitor? :tea: :droplet:
sam: :tea: please
leo: :droplet: (water for me)
frontdesk: We'll offer both. Facilities, can janitorial check the quiet corner for cushion and rug tripping hazards?
facilities: On it  I'll do a quick sweep at 3:05 and place a non-slip mat by the chair if needed.
sam: Thanks everyone. I'll have her call when she's at the lobby so frontdesk can meet her and print the badge.
frontdesk: Perfect. Badge will be printed on arrival, locker code left if needed, and armchair reserved. See you at 3:15pm.
